column1: # The terms Lucene's numeric fields produce, and the epoch millisecond
# Oak converts a DATE to, for froe to replay.
# Generated inside the pinned Sling image against its own oak-lucene,
# The jcr-commons jar leads the class path deliberately: four jars in the
# image carry a copy of `org.apache.jackrabbit.util.ISO8601`, and the one
# that counts is the bundle that exports the package in OSGi, which is
# what Oak imports at runtime. The judge refuses to run if it loaded any
# other copy, and the first line below records which it was.
# Columns: `long`\t<value>            a LongField of that value
#          `double`\t<hex float>\t<raw bits as hex>   a DoubleField
